svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Long members: two 1,400 mm lengths. End members and ribs: five

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 660 mm lengths. All 30 x 20 x 1.5 tube, 30 mm side upright.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ribs at 350, 700 and 1,050 mm from one end, square to the long members.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Join every butt with an aluminium corner cleat inside the tubes and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 4.8 mm blind rivets (or TIG weld). Frame 1,400 x 700 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Face (top): flat within 2 mm; the module is bonded to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inner long member (hinge side): M4 rivet nuts every 150 mm in its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inner face, 10 mm below the top, for the hinge's moving leaf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outer long member: outrigger brackets underneath at 80 mm from each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end; tie bar bracket (left wing) or keeper (right wing) at each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: diagonals equal within 2 mm; frame does not rock on a table.
